headline: Sandesh announces resignation of Company Secretary Joshi Hardik Arunkumar
hook: Compliance officer steps down at Sandesh
summary: The Sandesh Limited has informed the stock exchange that Mr. Joshi Hardik Arunkumar has resigned from his position as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 14, 2026. Management has not yet announced a successor for the key managerial post. Key managerial exits at media companies often attract closer regulatory scrutiny regarding disclosure timelines. Retail investors should monitor future filings for the appointment of a new compliance head.
whats_next: Appointment of a new company secretary and compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management change with minimal direct impact on share price.
